text:
Sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the token validation outage — listing concrete remediation tasks. Please ack, pick an owner if not assigned, and add ETA. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/2918765432

Kevin: I can take the token validation audit (scan service for expired/unsigned tokens + validation gaps). Target: Fri EOD. Will post PR. :+1:

Tara: I'll own secrets rotation plan and rollout playbook (k8s secrets + vault rotations + runbook). Need a maintenance window. Propose next Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC.

Sanjay: I'll add audit-log retention + integrity checks. Also will add a daily job to verify ingestion. ETA 2 weeks.

Liz: Ops - can we get a low-traffic deploy slot for the secrets rotation? ops-bot, any constraints?

ops-bot: @Liz Deploy window availability check: next windows 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC, 2026-04-14 03:00 UTC. Please confirm 24h before.

Kevin: For the audit I sketched a quick command to find tokens issued without validation hooks:
```
# list all services missing validation middleware
rg "token.validate|checkSignature" -n services/ || true
```
I'll attach the full scanner in the PR.

Sara: Noting a recurring pattern: we saw token-skew incidents ~every 3 weeks across different services. Need a permanent alert and runbook. Kevin/Tara to sync on whether rotation cadence or validation enforcement is the fix.

Tara: Agree. I'll add a runbook section for rollbacks and emergency rotation. Also propose adding an SLO for token validation success rate.

Sanjay: Suggest monitoring rule: token_validation_failure_rate > 0.5% over 5m -> pager to security oncall. I'll draft the prometheus rule.

Liz: Ops can help wire the alert once the rule is merged. Also will reserve the deploy slot for the rotation window on Wed.

Sara: Great. To recap action owners & ETAs:
- Kevin: token validation audit + PR (Fri EOD)
- Tara: secrets rotation plan & runbook (propose window next Wed)
- Sanjay: audit-log retention checks + prometheus rule (2 weeks)
- Liz/ops-bot: deploy slot + wiring alerts (confirm 24h prior)

Sara: I'll schedule a short recurring remediation check (Mon 09:00 UTC) until all items are closed. Please update the postmortem checklist when tasks are done. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
